Languages: Excellent English (written and spoken) required; fluent German is a strong plus and highly preferred for the German market. jobs.description: Technical University Munich operates the high flux Neutron Source Heinz Maier-Leibnitz (FRM II) located at the scientific campus in Garching, Germany.
